item.title: github: Manage the code coverage ruleset condition with the REST API
item.description:
GitHub now supports managing the “Restrict code coverage” repository ruleset option through the generally available REST API, in addition to the existing UI. This lets admins enforce code coverage requirements programmatically.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Block pull requests with exposed secrets from merging
item.description:
GitHub added a repository ruleset capability to prevent pull requests from merging when they introduce exposed secrets. This extends rulesets as a repository-wide protection mechanism.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Automatically migrate branch protection rules to repository rulesets
item.description:
GitHub now lets you convert existing branch protection rules into repository rulesets from repository settings. This provides a direct migration path to the newer policy framework.

  • Source: GitHub
